answer: Under proof-of-scarcity webcam attestation, each new identity on the lagoon network must display a distinct government-style QR code mailed physically to a unique home address; each address can mint only one identity ever, so an attacker spawning n fake agents must rent n separate residences and receive n mailings, paying roughly 1200 dollars each, a nonlinear cost of 1200n versus 1200 for one identity. Honest agents near the ivory dune district pay once and prove liveness by holding the printed card beside their face on camera, keeping their total near the base fee.
